opening.argument: The material presents consumer gadgets through ordinary retail channels, with the title identifying “5 SECRET GADGETS ON AMAZON AND ALIEXPRESS” and the description providing a “PURCHASE LINK FOR SECRET GADGETS.” The narration reinforces that commercial purpose by directing viewers to the purchase link while discussing a consumer phone: “The purchase link is given in the description box below.” It then demonstrates and recommends additional products, including a Bluetooth gimbal and a selfie stick in a buying context. The separate statement, “Follow & Win Exciting Gifts,” is described as an engagement promotion, but its details are unspecified. Nothing in that statement by itself establishes deceptive solicitation or connects the reward to the gadget offers. The evidence therefore supports ordinary product commerce, without overclaiming any loss, intent, or outcome.
